cMeasures.label: Meeting regularity
cMeasures.plain: Of the weeks since each community enrolled (7-day weeks counted from its enrolment date), the share with at least one verified community meeting.
cMeasures.scope_note: PDD §8.1 P1 — target ≥ 80%. Numerator and denominator count the same 7-day weeks from each community's enrolment date; the window ends at Step-7 completion or pilot end (the report date while the pilot runs).
cMeasures.title: Meeting regularity

cMeasures.label: Step 7 on time
cMeasures.plain: Of enrolled communities whose 15 weeks since enrolment have run out (or that already finished Step 7), the share that completed Step 7 within 15 weeks. Reported, not paid on.
cMeasures.scope_note: PDD §8.1 P3 — target ≥ 75% (reported, not priced, §7.4). Denominator: enrolled communities, each counted once its 15-week window closes or it completes Step 7, so none is marked late early. Enrolment is filed on an unpaid form that does not reach Connect (PDD §5), so a community enrolled but never visited is absent from visit data; reconcile against the enrolment list in CommCare HQ.
cMeasures.title: On-time step progression

cMeasures.label: Household attendance
cMeasures.plain: Households represented at verified meetings, out of the community's enrolled households.
cMeasures.scope_note: PDD §8.2 S1 (Fixture's own definition). The PDD sets no target.
cMeasures.title: Household attendance

cMeasures.label: Women attending
cMeasures.plain: Of everyone attending verified meetings, the share who were women.
cMeasures.scope_note: PDD §8.2 S2. The PDD sets no target.
cMeasures.title: Female attendance

cMeasures.label: Spoke up
cMeasures.plain: Of everyone attending verified meetings, the share who spoke.
cMeasures.scope_note: PDD §8.2 S3. The PDD sets no target.
cMeasures.title: Overall participation

cMeasures.label: Women who spoke
cMeasures.plain: Of the women attending verified meetings, the share who spoke.
cMeasures.scope_note: PDD §8.2 S4. The PDD sets no target.
cMeasures.title: Female participation

cMeasures.label: Saving
cMeasures.plain: Of communities on Step 5 or later, the share whose latest meeting reported the community is saving.
cMeasures.scope_note: PDD §8.2 S5 — denominator restricted to Step 5+ (§5.6). The PDD sets no target.
cMeasures.title: Communities saving

cMeasures.label: Repeat counts
cMeasures.plain: Of verified meetings, the share whose attendance counts exactly repeat the previous meeting's — a review flag, not a rejection.
cMeasures.scope_note: PDD §5.4 repeat_counts_flag; S-1 review stratum (§7.2). The PDD sets no threshold.
cMeasures.title: Repeat-count flag rate

cMeasures.label: Location flags
cMeasures.plain: Of meeting records, the share whose location was missing, worse than 50 m, or more than 2 km from the community — reviewed, never a payment condition.
cMeasures.scope_note: PDD §5.7 location review; S-1 review stratum (§7.2). The PDD sets no threshold.
cMeasures.title: Location review flag rate

cMeasures.label: One-meeting steps
cMeasures.plain: Of the steps communities completed, the share marked complete at the step's first meeting — a review flag, since a step usually takes about two meetings.
cMeasures.scope_note: PDD §7.2 S-1 ("a step advanced after a single meeting"); §3.2 ~1.9 meetings per step. The PDD sets no threshold.
cMeasures.title: Single-meeting step rate

cMeasures.label: Within the cap
cMeasures.plain: Of verified meetings, the share within the community's first three on its step — the meetings the pilot pays for; the rest are recorded and unpaid.
cMeasures.scope_note: PDD §3.2 per-step cap (3 per step, payable_slot = yes, §7.1 rule 2). The PDD sets no target.
cMeasures.title: In-cap share of meetings
